market_question: Will Kolkata Knight Riders win the 2026 Indian Premier League?
reasoning: Kolkata Knight Riders are a strong IPL franchise, having won three titles including 2024. Even accounting for squad turnover before 2026, their historical win rate (≈8–10%) is far above the market-implied 0.7%. The market appears to heavily discount a top team, creating a large edge.
evidence_points: KKR have won IPL titles in 2012, 2014, and 2024, showing consistent competitiveness.
In a 10-team league, a naive average win probability is 10%, and KKR are generally above average.
The 2026 season is a year away, but franchise strength and management suggest a significantly higher true probability than 0.7%.
